column1: # REQ-043 priority 3 (alignment ratio) + priority 2 (second training state). align_ratio = ||Sum_t d_t a_t^T||_F / (||d||_F ||a||_F) = ||W.grad||_F/(||d||_F ||a||_F).

# KEY IDENTITY (a_rms identical for q/k/v, band 21): align_deficit == grad_deficit - d_deficit EXACTLY. So the alignment ratio IS band-25's missing factor.
# n=4: align_deficit = -0.1896 dex (0.646x), across-seed sd = 0.0059 (band-25 filed shortfall -0.240+-0.041; this single-state value is tighter and artifact-free)
